_help: Add one { } block per article inside 'articles'. Required: id (unique, lowercase, no spaces, e.g. 'berat-wins'), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: summary (shown on cards), category (becomes a filter button), author, image (file name), imageAlt, imageCaption, tags (list), featured (true = lead story), breaking (true = blue strip at the top), draft (true = hidden), body (list: each string is a paragraph; '## text' = sub-heading; '> text' = pull quote; **bold** works). Articles dated in the future stay hidden until that day.

articles.title: Sample story: how to write an article
articles.summary: This sample shows every part of an article. Edit it or delete it, then add your own stories.
articles.author: OS Times Staff
body: The **body** is a list. Each line in the list is one paragraph, and you can wrap words in double asterisks to make them bold.
A line that starts with two hashes and a space becomes a sub-heading, like the one above.
> A line that starts with a greater-than sign and a space becomes a pull quote.
Add a picture by putting its file name in "image", for example "photos/story.jpg".

articles.title: Sample story: scheduling and drafts
articles.summary: Set a future date to publish later, or mark an article as a draft to hide it.
articles.author: OS Times Staff
body: Articles with a date in the future stay hidden until that day. Articles with "draft": true stay hidden until you change it to false.
Set "breaking": true on a story to show a blue Breaking strip with its title across the top of the site.
